messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features documents for our products, official competitor datasheets/brochures or third-party evidence for the competitor, and claim-specific proof such as option codes, software versions, test conditions, validation reports, accreditation evidence, configuration tools, quotes, or TCO calculations where the comparison depends on them [2][6][70][73].
### Required evidence by claim type
| Claim area | Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Overall competitor comparison | Treat R&S battle cards as sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, and do not use “Only R&S,” “industry’s only,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” or similar wording as verified technical facts without formal proof [1][2][5][6][37][73]. | The Wiki repeatedly states that these pages are sales positioning and not formal specifications, and that sales language cannot be treated as verifiable specs [1][2][5][6][37][73]. |
| R&S Signaling Tester claims | Use the formal CMX500 specifications document and CMX500 Features and Functions document, with their version/date and limits/conditions, because CMX500 formal evidence is tied to `CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100` and `CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32` [7][78]. | CMX500 specs are the binding specifications source, while the features document is a features/functions overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding [78]. |
| R&S CMX500 options and WLAN signaling | Cite the actual CMX500 feature/options evidence, such as WLAN signaling option codes R&S CMX-KS350B, KS351B, KS352B, KS353B, KS355B, KS356B, KS357B, KS360B, and KS365B, rather than general battle-card language [75]. | The CMX500 WLAN option table gives the supported WLAN signaling option codes and order-number patterns, while the battle-card comparison says CMX500 WLAN claims must be checked against the formal features document [75][62]. |
| R&S Non-signaling / production path claims | Use product-specific formal sources for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06 rather than a battle-card statement that they form a production path [18][20][23][31]. | The Amarisoft battle-card relationship notes that CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06 are described as production / non-signaling / ATE path, but formal claims must come from each product page/source [31]. |
| CMP180 claims | Use CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00, and cite the specifications document for measurement ranges and tolerance limits [18]. | The CMP180 page states that the features document is a test applications overview and that measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be referenced from the specifications document PD 3609.7348.22 [18]. |
| CMP200 claims | Use the CMP200 Radio Communication Tester Specifications Data Sheet, PD 5216.4391.22, Version 08.00, August 2024, and respect “data without tolerance limits is not binding” [20]. | The CMP200 page identifies this data sheet as the source for hardware, IF, RRH, ordering, mechanical, environmental, and conformance-related claims, and states that data without tolerance limits is not binding [20]. |
| CMW100 K06 claims | Use `CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500`, PD 5214.8348.22, Version 05.00, September 2025, and distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable data [22][23]. | The CMW100 K06 page defines which specification types are warranted and says non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed [22]. |
| CMW500 legacy / wireless-standard claims | Use `CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700`, PD 5213.9211.22, Version 17.00, April 2023, and apply its calibration, warm-up, environmental, typical-value, and nominal-value conditions [46][81]. | The CMW500 data sheet passage gives the formal source/version and states that data without tolerance limits is not binding and that typical and nominal values are not guaranteed [46][81]. |
| Competitor claims for Amarisoft | Obtain Amarisoft official documents or third-party evidence before using claims about Amarisoft support, Wi-Fi signaling, production/ATE limitations, global footprint, UE count, NB-IoT, LTE-M, RedCap, NTN, or certification acceptance [2][25][62]. | The Wiki says Amarisoft claims currently come from an R&S internal battle card and that customer documents should separately check Amarisoft official material and third-party evidence [2][25]. |
| Competitor claims for Anritsu | Obtain Anritsu official sources or third-party evidence before citing MT8000A FR2 frequency, bandwidth, throughput, FR3 range, WLAN gaps, LTE RF dependencies, production flow, or software-fragmentation conclusions [6][44][64][67]. | The Wiki says the Anritsu battle-card claims mainly come from an R&S internal battle card and require Anritsu official evidence for customer use; the Anritsu MX844030PC official brochure can describe MX844030PC but cannot validate R&S CMX500 advantages [6][67]. |
| Competitor claims for Keysight | Obtain Keysight official datasheets, option/configuration documents, service terms, or third-party evidence for E7515P/W/B/E/R, WLAN capability, RedCap, FR3/6G roadmap, support model, software toolchain, and UXM architecture claims [38][69][70]. | The Keysight battle-card unresolved section says it lacks formal Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers, dates, RFU18 formal evidence, NTN validation reports, and proof for sales-language claims such as only, first, leadership, lower TCO, and fewer boxes [70]. |
| RF / bandwidth / data-rate comparisons | Use formal datasheets, option documents, and measurement conditions, especially when battle-card numbers conflict with CMX500 formal specs or RFU18 is involved [42][59][72]. | The Wiki flags FR1 bandwidth, FR2 instantaneous bandwidth, data-rate, FR1 up-to-18 GHz, RFU18, and 2000 MHz bandwidth statements as battle-card or PR/roadmap claims that cannot be used as binding specifications without formal RFU18/CMX500 evidence [42][59][72]. |
| FR3 / RFU18 claims | Use RFU18 formal datasheet, order/configuration evidence, supported CMX500 configuration rules, calibration conditions, availability, and test conditions before making formal FR3 or 18 GHz comparison claims [40][41][59][70]. | The RFU18/FR3 passages state that PR and battle-card claims do not provide formal RFU18 datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, MCS, software release, or measurement conditions, and cannot be backfilled into existing CMX500 formal specifications [40][41][59][70]. |
| Conformance / operator acceptance claims | Use validation reports, accreditation evidence, test package option codes, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF or operator acceptance evidence, test-plan versions, IDs, dates, and acceptance criteria before claiming validated conformance or operator certification superiority [52][62][70]. | The Wiki states that conformance/operator claims lack test package option codes, accreditation documents, validation reports, PTCRB RFT versions, test case lists, validation IDs, scenario IDs, test-plan versions, validation dates, and operator acceptance letters [52][62][70]. |
| NTN / RedCap leadership claims | Use formal validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF or operator evidence, option/configuration details, and dates before claiming “first,” “validated,” or superior NTN/RedCap coverage [52][62][70]. | The Keysight and NetOp passages state that Samsung NTN validation, operator coverage, unique vendor, leading coverage, and validation-count claims require validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB versions, dates, operator evidence, or certification evidence [52][70]. |
| Fading, IP throughput, application testing | Use formal CMX500 features/options and formal competitor workflow/option evidence rather than battle-card statements about integrated fading, IP throughput, or external PCs/tools [10][38][62][74]. | CMX500 features list fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and CMX500 application options, while competitor-side statements in comparison tables are marked as needing option codes, formal workflows, or official competitor data [10][38][62][74]. |
| Software / automation comparison | Use formal R&S interface documentation and official competitor software documentation before claiming unified workflow or fragmented toolchain [67][77]. | CMX500 formal features list CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI, and SCPI, while the Anritsu official brochure evidence supports an MX844030PC common RTD GUI integration aspect that must be kept separate from R&S battle-card fragmentation positioning [67][77]. |
| Support, warranty, calibration, and service claims | Use formal service contracts, warranty terms, calibration terms, and official competitor service documents before comparing support models or calibration footprint [2][20][22][46][62][69]. | Battle-card support statements for competitors lack official or third-party support evidence, while R&S product sources specify calibration intervals, warranty/service conditions, and which data is binding or non-binding [2][20][22][46][62][69]. |
| TCO, fewer boxes, lower cost, or commercial advantage | Use a documented TCO formula, configuration bill of materials, licenses, calibration/service assumptions, pricing/quotes, and measurement of throughput or utilization before making commercial superiority claims [39][65][70]. | The Wiki says TCO messages such as fewer boxes, fewer licenses, lower TCO, and higher throughput are sales messages and lack a TCO formula or formal supporting evidence [39][65][70]. |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- “Only R&S” 與 “safe and future-proof choice” 是 battle card 的 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- 對 [[amarisoft]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 [[amarisoft]] 官方資料與第三方證據。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 核心 thesis
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），R&S 對 [[amarisoft]] 的核心定位是：[[R&S CMX500]] 與 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 提供 instrument-grade、validated、calibrated、可延伸至 production 的 5G testing path；[[amarisoft]] 則被描述為 COTS hardware + software-defined stack 的 functional testing solution。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 架構 | one-platform architecture；FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + Wi-Fi + RF + fading | multiple RF boards、external converters、multiple boxes；另依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]，[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 software-based [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，可用 MAC / PHY Digital-IQ / RF interfaces | battle card 未提供正式 CMX500 RFU18 或 Anritsu module datasheet；MX844030PC brochure 未提供 CMX500 比較資料 |
| FR1 bandwidth | quick table: 500 MHz (& future scalable) | 200/400 MHz fixed limit；landmine 稱 max 400 MHz per module | R&S 500 MHz 口徑與既有 specifications 不完全一致，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| FR2 | up to 50 GHz；source claim >16 GHz instantaneous bandwidth；>10 Gbps data rate | up to 43.5 GHz；800 MHz BW；up to 5 Gbps | R&S up to 50.20 GHz 與 specs 方向一致；>16 GHz bandwidth / >10 Gbps 仍缺正式規格來源 |
| FR3 | via upcoming [[RFU18]]；quick table says up to 18 GHz | new FR3 module 0.4–16 GHz | 兩方數字皆需正式 datasheet 驗證 |
| Fading | integrated / native fading | external PC software / chambers / software | source 未列 option code 對照 |
| IP throughput | native high-throughput IP testing | IP Option 012 + external PC | source 未列 throughput profile 或測試條件 |
| Software | single workflow / unified automation / Test Automation Suite | Battle card says SSNR + RTD + ATS + MX844030PC；[[mx844030pc-j1200]] says MX844030PC uses common RTD GUI for protocol test case transfer | battle card 是 R&S sales framing；Anritsu brochure 是 MX844030PC official product framing，兩者不可直接合併成單一事實 |
| WLAN | cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform；Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling inside CMX500 | MT8000A no WLAN；requires [[Anritsu MT8862A]] | CMX500 WLAN 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Anritsu]] 的 battle card 主張目前主要來自 R&S internal battle card；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Anritsu 官方資料與第三方證據。
- [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 是 Anritsu product brochure，可用於描述 [[Anritsu MX844030PC]]、[[Anritsu MD8190A]] 與 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]]，但不可用來驗證 R&S 對 CMX500 的優勢主張。
- Source 中的 only platform、industry-leading、widest frequency range、lower TCO 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- FR1 / FR2 / FR3 bandwidth 與 data rate 相關矛盾與限制已集中標註於 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]]。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft]]、[[R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu]] 同屬 2026-02-26 R&S battle card 類型來源；三者都應視為競品銷售定位，而不是正式規格來源。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的正式規格仍需以 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]（Version 11.00，August 2025）與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]（Version 32，CSW 9.20.0 and higher）追溯。
- 本來源提到 [[R&S CMW500]] covers all legacy + EN-DC；[[R&S CMW500]] 的正式資料需追溯 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- 本來源新增 [[Keysight]] 在 wireless device testing battle card 語境中的公司與 UXM portfolio 描述；既有 [[Keysight]] 頁主要來自高頻高速 PCB 測試圖像來源，兩者資料層次不同。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Keysight 相關
- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。
- [[ProbSim]] — channel emulator；來源在 integrated vs external fading landmine 中列名。
- [[RaySim]] — digital twin / ray tracing engine；來源說 advanced fading、digital twin、FR3 / 6G scenarios 可能需要 RaySim。
- [[Channel Studio]] — channel modeling / fading 相關 external tool。
- [[Nemo]] — field test tools；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[Atlas]] — AI-powered device test / test management；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[KeysightCare]] — 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered KeysightCare：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，以及 optional warranty / calibration assurance plan。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMW500 › 訂購資訊

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S CMW100 K06 › 規格資料的使用限制
[[CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500]] 對規格類型定義如下：

- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits 標示為 n. trc.，因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，產品性能不保證。
- Specifications without limits 代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- Typical data 標示為 typ.，若標示為 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表生產時約 80% instruments 可達到的 performance；否則代表 mean value。
- Nominal values 標示為 nom.，不進行 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試該參數。
- Measured values 標示為 meas.，以個別 samples 的 measurement results 描述 expected product performance。
- Uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 定義，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 保證。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；Subject to change。

⚠️ [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）說 quick comparison table 中 [[R&S CMX500]] FR1 bandwidth 為 **500 MHz (& future scalable)**，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 說 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF generator RF bandwidth **250 MHz**、RF analyzer demodulation bandwidth **250 MHz**，而 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 說 RF unit 每個 RX 最高 **500 MHz bandwidth**、每個 TX 最高 **200 MHz total carrier bandwidth**。判斷：battle card 的 FR1 500 MHz 說法與正式規格口徑不同；報價、規格比較或承諾前需回查正式 CMX500 / RFU option 文件。

Anritsu MT8000A
[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 是 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中列出的 Anritsu 5G NR FR1 / FR2 / FR3 測試平台；目前本頁只記錄 R&S battle card 的競品描述，尚未匯入 Anritsu 官方 datasheet。

Anritsu MT8000A › 與 R&S CMX500 比較時的注意事項
- [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 single integrated platform，對比 [[Anritsu MT8000A]] 的 multi-box / multi-board approach。
- 但該來源是 sales battle card，不是 Anritsu 官方規格，也不是 R&S CMX500 binding specifications。
- 若要對客戶引用 MT8000A 的 FR2 43.5 GHz、800 MHz BW、5 Gbps、FR3 0.4–16 GHz 等數字，需補 Anritsu 官方來源。

Anritsu MT8000A › Battle card 中的定位
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26），[[Anritsu MT8000A]] 被列為 Anritsu mobile test portfolio 的 5G NR FR1 / FR2 / FR3 平台，但 source 認為其架構 fragmented：

- 需要 separate RF boards for FR1 / FR2 / FR3。
- FR2 OTA、high CA 與 mobility cases 可能需要 multiple MT8000As。
- FR2 使用 external mmWave converters。
- IP throughput 需要 IP Option 012 + external PC。
- Fading 需要 external PC software / external setup。
- WLAN signaling 不在 MT8000A 內，需 [[Anritsu MT8862A]] 作為 separate WLAN tester。
- Legacy LTE RF 仍需 [[Anritsu MT8821C]]。

CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700 › 規格條件與可信度限制
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 指定規格需符合至少 15 minutes warm-up time、指定 environmental conditions、calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 代表 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 是 design parameters，產品開發期間驗證，但 production 期間不特別測試，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- 每台儀器在生產流程中依 defined procedures 校正；放行條件包含所有 measurement results 與 calibration system measurement uncertainties 必須落在 published specification limits 內。
- Calibration system expanded measurement uncertainties 以 coverage factor k = 2 決定，通常約 95 % probability。
- 斜體參數可直接在 tester 上設定。

CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S CMW100 K06]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz CMW / radio communication tester 產品資料，但本來源涵蓋的是 [[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMW290]]、[[R&S CMW270]] 的 wideband radio communication tester data sheet。
- 本來源補足 [[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMW290]]、[[R&S CMW270]] 的正式訂購型號、Order No.、Version 17.00 規格條件、RF path 組態、bandwidth unit、wireless standards、DAU、Digital I/Q、service options 與 recommended extras。
- 本來源沒有提供完整 available options order number；原文要求參考 product brochure PD 5214.2833.12 或洽 local Rohde & Schwarz expert。

CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700 › 測試技術與標準
- [[GSM]]、[[NB-IoT]]、[[WCDMA]]、[[LTE]]、[[LTE C-V2X]]、[[Bluetooth]]、[[GPS]]、[[DVB-T]]、[[FM STEREO RADIO]]、[[WLAN]]、[[LR-WPAN]]、[[TD-SCDMA]]、[[CDMA2000 1xRTT]]、[[CDMA2000 1xEV-DO]]、[[NR Sub-6GHz]]。
- [[Digital I-Q]]、[[Data application unit]]、[[ARB]]、[[RF spectrum analyzer]]、[[FFT spectrum analyzer]]、[[Power meter]]、[[Timebase]]。
- 來源明示 Bluetooth standard 為 Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0，test standard 包含 Bluetooth RF Test Specification RF.TS.5.0.0 與 Bluetooth Low Energy RF PHY Test Specification RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- 來源明示 LR-WPAN standard 為 IEEE 802.15.4 - 2011。
- WLAN 涵蓋 IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac；160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節另列 IEEE 802.11ax。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的公司輪廓
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

- 來源為 company restricted PPTX 的 lossy markdown derivative；圖片、表格、logo、圖中連線與註解可能遺失，原 PPTX 才是 source of truth。
- 來源未提供正式 R&S document number、author、revision history、完整 confidentiality policy 或 distribution restriction。
- Slide 6 的價格與 test case counts 為 sales / battle-card 型資料，未提供 quote validity、地域、折扣、support / maintenance、software version 或 official price list。

R-S-portfolio-for-O-RU-testing_MARCH_2025_R-S_INTERNAL_ONLY_SHORT › 與既有知識的關係
- 相較 [[R&S portfolio for O-RU testing]]（August 2023），本來源是 2025-03 的 short version，新增 O-RU tester market / funding、PVT360A cost-optimized positioning、NES / EE、M-MIMO with BFM、competitor positioning、VIAVI VAR agreement 與 NTIA funded labs 資訊。

RFU18 › 來源中的定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]：

- [[RFU18]] 是 new RFU18 board。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester extended with the new RFU18 board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform。
- 來源稱它 gives customers a straightforward, cost-effective path to extend existing testers towards [[6G]]。
- 來源稱 all existing [[R&S CMX500]] platforms can be enhanced with the new RFU18 board to extend frequency coverage and capabilities without replacing the entire system。
- [[Goce Talaganov]] 的引言說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] is extending the [[R&S CMX500]] platform to **18 GHz** so customers gain headroom for [[FR3]] evolution and higher-frequency emissions and harmonic testing。

依 [[RFU8VSRFU18]]：

- Official product name / module ID：RF Unit, [[R&S CMX-B650A]]。
- Product relationship：Parallel/alternative RF unit；co-exists with [[CMX-B600B]] for the foreseeable future；NOT a successor/replacement。
- Chassis requirement：requires [[R&S CMX-PB70H]] assembly。
- Frequency range：**0.4 GHz – 18 GHz**。
- Module composition：4× downlink engines + 2× uplink engines。
- Slot placement：Front slots 1–5，same slot family as [[CMX-B600B]]。
- Mixing：RFU8 + RFU18 supported；RFU18 + IFU not supported。

RFU18 › 與既有 CMX500 正式規格的關係
⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）說 [[RFU18]] 可將 [[R&S CMX500]] coverage extend up to 18 GHz，且 all existing CMX500 platforms can be enhanced with RFU18，但既有頁面 [[R&S CMX500]] 說 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]（August 2025）正式規格只列 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 400 MHz to 8000 MHz、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF generator 6 GHz to 20 GHz / analyzer 4 GHz to 20 GHz，且未列 RFU18。判斷：這是較新的 PR / upgrade claim，不能回填成 August 2025 formal specifications；正式報價與規格仍需 RFU18 datasheet / configure 工具確認。

⚠️ [[RFU8VSRFU18]]（2026-09-24）說 [[RFU18]] requires [[R&S CMX-PB70H]] assembly，且 [[RFU18]] + IFU not supported，但既有頁面 [[RFU18]] 說 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]] claim 為 all existing CMX500 platforms can be enhanced with RFU18。判斷：以本 production comparison table 作為 configuration restriction 補充；PR 的 all existing wording 不可解讀為任意 IFU / chassis configuration 皆可升級。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）說 [[R&S CMX500]] engineered for data rates up to 20 Gbps、supporting 4096QAM and up to 16 device antenna ports，但既有頁面 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 說 2026-02-26 battle cards 曾記錄 >10 Gbps 或 RFU18 max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz，且 [[R&S CMX500]] 正式 specs / Features 頁面未提供同一條件下的 20 Gbps / 4096QAM / 16 ports binding specification。判斷：20 Gbps、4096QAM、16 ports 目前只能標為 PR platform-level claim，不能當作無條件規格。

RFU18 › Beta scope and limitations
依 [[RFU8VSRFU18]]，RFU18 beta scope / limitations：

- Signaling support current / beta：**NR FR1 and LTE only**。
- NR FR2、WiFi、NB-IoT：out of scope for Beta。
- Measurement instances：2 measurement instances + 1 generator instance per RFU18。
- Max input power：+27 dBm PEP。
- Level alignment：±5 dB。
- Normal mode only：2×500 MHz；no 1 GHz broadband mode。
- Max 8 CCs per RFU18。
- 4×100 MHz CCs per Tx。
- 1 [[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] instance per RFU18。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | amarisoft positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公司與支援 | Global support、field engineering、calibration labs、service contracts、multi-year warranties | small French private company；remote-only support；no global footprint | [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 未引用第三方或 amarisoft 官方文件 |
| FR1 / FR2 | [[R&S CMX500]] covers FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz / calibrated FR2 | external RRH for FR2，calibration 以問號標示 | “up to 50 GHz” 為 battle card 說法；正式規格需引用 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] |
| Wi-Fi signaling | [[R&S CMX500]] integrated Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 | external AP/N3IWF 或 no Wi-Fi signaling | Wi-Fi feature 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] |
| Conformance / operator acceptance | PTCRB/GCF aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests | functional only；not accepted for operator certification | 來源未列 test package option code 或 accreditation 文件 |
| Validated NTN | validated NR-NTN RF / RRM / protocol testcases，來源括註 w/ Samsung | functional simulation only | 未列 Samsung validation report 或 test case list |
| Legacy RAT | [[R&S CMW500]] 支援 2G/3G continuity | no 2G/3G stack | CMW500 正式能力需引用 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] |
| Production path | [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production / ATE / non-signaling path | no non-signaling platform、no production scaling path | 各 production platform 規格需分別引用其正式 source pages |
| Load / flexibility | battle card 主張 R&S validated testing | excellent functional load testing、up to 1000 UEs、flexible for NB-IoT / LTE-M / RedCap / basic NTN | amarisoft 能力缺少版本與硬體條件 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Anritsu positioning | 來源限制 |

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor without unsupported claims, use formal R&S specifications/features documents for our products, official competitor datasheets/brochures or third-party evidence for the competitor, and claim-specific proof such as option codes, software versions, test conditions, validation reports, accreditation evidence, configuration tools, quotes, or TCO calculations where the comparison depends on them [2][6][70][73].
### Required evidence by claim type
| Claim area | Evidence required | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Overall competitor comparison | Treat R&S battle cards as sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, and do not use “Only R&S,” “industry’s only,” “future-proof,” “lower TCO,” or similar wording as verified technical facts without formal proof [1][2][5][6][37][73]. | The Wiki repeatedly states that these pages are sales positioning and not formal specifications, and that sales language cannot be treated as verifiable specs [1][2][5][6][37][73]. |
| R&S Signaling Tester claims | Use the formal CMX500 specifications document and CMX500 Features and Functions document, with their version/date and limits/conditions, because CMX500 formal evidence is tied to `CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100` and `CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32` [7][78]. | CMX500 specs are the binding specifications source, while the features document is a features/functions overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding [78]. |
| R&S CMX500 options and WLAN signaling | Cite the actual CMX500 feature/options evidence, such as WLAN signaling option codes R&S CMX-KS350B, KS351B, KS352B, KS353B, KS355B, KS356B, KS357B, KS360B, and KS365B, rather than general battle-card language [75]. | The CMX500 WLAN option table gives the supported WLAN signaling option codes and order-number patterns, while the battle-card comparison says CMX500 WLAN claims must be checked against the formal features document [75][62]. |
| R&S Non-signaling / production path claims | Use product-specific formal sources for CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06 rather than a battle-card statement that they form a production path [18][20][23][31]. | The Amarisoft battle-card relationship notes that CMP180, CMP200, and CMW100 K06 are described as production / non-signaling / ATE path, but formal claims must come from each product page/source [31]. |
| CMP180 claims | Use CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 and CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00, and cite the specifications document for measurement ranges and tolerance limits [18]. | The CMP180 page states that the features document is a test applications overview and that measurement ranges and tolerance limits must be referenced from the specifications document PD 3609.7348.22 [18]. |
| CMP200 claims | Use the CMP200 Radio Communication Tester Specifications Data Sheet, PD 5216.4391.22, Version 08.00, August 2024, and respect “data without tolerance limits is not binding” [20]. | The CMP200 page identifies this data sheet as the source for hardware, IF, RRH, ordering, mechanical, environmental, and conformance-related claims, and states that data without tolerance limits is not binding [20]. |
| CMW100 K06 claims | Use `CMW100-K06_specs_en_5214-8348-22_v0500`, PD 5214.8348.22, Version 05.00, September 2025, and distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, and non-traceable data [22][23]. | The CMW100 K06 page defines which specification types are warranted and says non-traceable specifications, typical data, nominal values, and measured values are not guaranteed [22]. |
| CMW500 legacy / wireless-standard claims | Use `CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700`, PD 5213.9211.22, Version 17.00, April 2023, and apply its calibration, warm-up, environmental, typical-value, and nominal-value conditions [46][81]. | The CMW500 data sheet passage gives the formal source/version and states that data without tolerance limits is not binding and that typical and nominal values are not guaranteed [46][81]. |
| Competitor claims for Amarisoft | Obtain Amarisoft official documents or third-party evidence before using claims about Amarisoft support, Wi-Fi signaling, production/ATE limitations, global footprint, UE count, NB-IoT, LTE-M, RedCap, NTN, or certification acceptance [2][25][62]. | The Wiki says Amarisoft claims currently come from an R&S internal battle card and that customer documents should separately check Amarisoft official material and third-party evidence [2][25]. |
| Competitor claims for Anritsu | Obtain Anritsu official sources or third-party evidence before citing MT8000A FR2 frequency, bandwidth, throughput, FR3 range, WLAN gaps, LTE RF dependencies, production flow, or software-fragmentation conclusions [6][44][64][67]. | The Wiki says the Anritsu battle-card claims mainly come from an R&S internal battle card and require Anritsu official evidence for customer use; the Anritsu MX844030PC official brochure can describe MX844030PC but cannot validate R&S CMX500 advantages [6][67]. |
| Competitor claims for Keysight | Obtain Keysight official datasheets, option/configuration documents, service terms, or third-party evidence for E7515P/W/B/E/R, WLAN capability, RedCap, FR3/6G roadmap, support model, software toolchain, and UXM architecture claims [38][69][70]. | The Keysight battle-card unresolved section says it lacks formal Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers, dates, RFU18 formal evidence, NTN validation reports, and proof for sales-language claims such as only, first, leadership, lower TCO, and fewer boxes [70]. |
| RF / bandwidth / data-rate comparisons | Use formal datasheets, option documents, and measurement conditions, especially when battle-card numbers conflict with CMX500 formal specs or RFU18 is involved [42][59][72]. | The Wiki flags FR1 bandwidth, FR2 instantaneous bandwidth, data-rate, FR1 up-to-18 GHz, RFU18, and 2000 MHz bandwidth statements as battle-card or PR/roadmap claims that cannot be used as binding specifications without formal RFU18/CMX500 evidence [42][59][72]. |
| FR3 / RFU18 claims | Use RFU18 formal datasheet, order/configuration evidence, supported CMX500 configuration rules, calibration conditions, availability, and test conditions before making formal FR3 or 18 GHz comparison claims [40][41][59][70]. | The RFU18/FR3 passages state that PR and battle-card claims do not provide formal RFU18 datasheet, order number, bandwidth, throughput, MCS, software release, or measurement conditions, and cannot be backfilled into existing CMX500 formal specifications [40][41][59][70]. |
| Conformance / operator acceptance claims | Use validation reports, accreditation evidence, test package option codes, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF or operator acceptance evidence, test-plan versions, IDs, dates, and acceptance criteria before claiming validated conformance or operator certification superiority [52][62][70]. | The Wiki states that conformance/operator claims lack test package option codes, accreditation documents, validation reports, PTCRB RFT versions, test case lists, validation IDs, scenario IDs, test-plan versions, validation dates, and operator acceptance letters [52][62][70]. |
| NTN / RedCap leadership claims | Use formal validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF or operator evidence, option/configuration details, and dates before claiming “first,” “validated,” or superior NTN/RedCap coverage [52][62][70]. | The Keysight and NetOp passages state that Samsung NTN validation, operator coverage, unique vendor, leading coverage, and validation-count claims require validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB versions, dates, operator evidence, or certification evidence [52][70]. |
| Fading, IP throughput, application testing | Use formal CMX500 features/options and formal competitor workflow/option evidence rather than battle-card statements about integrated fading, IP throughput, or external PCs/tools [10][38][62][74]. | CMX500 features list fading, AWGN, BLER, throughput measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and CMX500 application options, while competitor-side statements in comparison tables are marked as needing option codes, formal workflows, or official competitor data [10][38][62][74]. |
| Software / automation comparison | Use formal R&S interface documentation and official competitor software documentation before claiming unified workflow or fragmented toolchain [67][77]. | CMX500 formal features list CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI, and SCPI, while the Anritsu official brochure evidence supports an MX844030PC common RTD GUI integration aspect that must be kept separate from R&S battle-card fragmentation positioning [67][77]. |
| Support, warranty, calibration, and service claims | Use formal service contracts, warranty terms, calibration terms, and official competitor service documents before comparing support models or calibration footprint [2][20][22][46][62][69]. | Battle-card support statements for competitors lack official or third-party support evidence, while R&S product sources specify calibration intervals, warranty/service conditions, and which data is binding or non-binding [2][20][22][46][62][69]. |
| TCO, fewer boxes, lower cost, or commercial advantage | Use a documented TCO formula, configuration bill of materials, licenses, calibration/service assumptions, pricing/quotes, and measurement of throughput or utilization before making commercial superiority claims [39][65][70]. | The Wiki says TCO messages such as fewer boxes, fewer licenses, lower TCO, and higher throughput are sales messages and lack a TCO formula or formal supporting evidence [39][65][70]. |
